items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is on the field in Brazil testing his hamstring; looks good but team mulling decision and previously not counting on him playing. True pregame GTD.
items.why: Hamstring; limited Friday after DNPs; team not counting on him; field conditions factor.
items.implication: Late swap critical for 4:25pm Brazil game; if OUT, Bateman/Andrews elevate.
items.opportunity: Targets to Andrews/Bateman/Henry if limited or out.

items.text: ETR/Levitan projecting Zay Flowers OUT in projections; keep late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS. Still possible he plays after test.
items.why: Team not counting on him; hamstring history matching prior miss.
items.implication: Fade Flowers; elevate Ravens pass catchers in DFS/late swap.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell (finger, Q/GTD) inactive vs Lions. Expected inactive per sources.
items.implication: Garrett Wilson massive target share bump; Jets WRs thin.
items.opportunity: Wilson alpha; slot/TE Kenyon Sadiq more routes per Levitan.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker active; Xavier Legette out. Spears up for Titans.
items.implication: Coker viable with target share; Legette absence concentrates.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play and confirmed active vs Chargers. Keon Coleman also active.
items.why: Shoulder from Week 2; source confirmation then inactives.
items.implication: Start with confidence in high-scoring Bills offense; limited possible per ETR.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route share expected.

items.text: ETR Sunday summary: Flowers GTD (not counting on), Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson trending in, Bagent.
items.implication: Clear most Qs to play; monitor Flowers/Spears late.
items.opportunity: Full roles for expected; beneficiaries locked if confirmed OUT elsewhere.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week injury per sources (with Rapoport). Noted quick healer hoping to beat it.
items.why: Grade 2 strain; scar tissue pain noted.
items.implication: Bagent or other starts; Bears pass catchers downgraded short-term.
items.opportunity: Monitor backup QB usage for Odunze/Moore/Loveland.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight week (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Schultz elevated again; start TE with confidence vs Colts.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share last week with Collins out; Colts allow TE yards.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) expected to play and active vs Bengals. Pittman also expected/active.
items.why: Shoulder; expected confirmation Sunday AM then actives.
items.implication: Warren lead back with Dowdle OUT; startable RB2/flex.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps without Dowdle; goal-line work.

items.text: Projecting Brock Bowers (knee Q) and Mike Evans (hip Q) IN despite questionable tags.
items.why: Practice trends and reports; ETR expected list.
items.implication: Start both with confidence; elite TE/WR floors.

items.text: Saquon Barkley and Devonta Smith expected to play (from Q/stinger concerns).
items.why: Weekend reports; stinger for Barkley cleared per prior.
items.implication: Full workloads expected Monday/Thursday? Wait Sunday slate.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; smash spot even if Flowers limited.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% targets both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.opportunity: Deep targets and air yards share.

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17. Mariota history solid but matchup tanks.
items.why: Brutal defense + low total; Daniels out.

items.text: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead Wk3.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet; committee.
items.opportunity: Henderson pass-pro trust key for more work; monitor.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson higher short-term.

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz 28-30% target share/routes. Loves vs IND (allows TE yards).
items.why: Team-high target share last week; matchup.
items.implication: Strong TE1 play while Collins out.

items.text: Drake London with Penix: 12 career games avg 20+ PPR, 35% targets, 97 rec yds.
